influences.name: Robert W. Chambers
influences.context: Stranger draws from supernatural horror novels surreal literature. He found himself attracted to the mystery of Carcosa, a mysterious fictional city that's turned up across literature for over one hundred years, with album closer "Yellowman" heavily referencing Robert W. Chambers' 1895 novel The King in Yellow.

influences.name: Yukio Mishima

influences.name: Edgar Allan Poe
